target.outcome: County ischemic and hemorrhagic stroke mortality among adults aged 65 years or older
target.geography: United States counties and county equivalents, excluding Puerto Rico, American Samoa, Guam, and US Virgin Islands
target.effect_scale: Linear mortality-rate difference (deaths per 100,000) per +1 ug/m3 PM2.5; published model includes stated county covariates

sources.role: public outcome release assessed but not used

substitutions.reanalysis: EPA AQS 2020 PM2.5 monitor-day arithmetic-mean county aggregation
substitutions.reason: Independent public source required; this monitor-only, single-year assignment is documented but not used to fit the target model.

coverage.notes: EPA monitor exposure table has 625 county FIPS for 2020, but no units/times were included in an analysis panel because a compatible target outcome was not retrieved.

blockers: No compatible public county outcome for ischemic and hemorrhagic stroke mortality among adults 65+ for 2016-2020 was retrieved. CDC WONDER D176 returned HTTP 500; the alternative accessible CDC Atlas release is all-stroke, age 35+, 2018-2020 three-year age-adjusted/smoothed data and was not substituted.
Consequently the target outcome cannot be joined to the published covariate set and independent exposure without materially changing the scientific question; no regression was run.
